jobs_results.title: Deep Learning Intern
jobs_results.description:
Join Wipro in Coimbatore as a Deep Learning Intern. This entry-level internship is built for candidates early in their journey who are eager to turn classroom knowledge into hands-on machine learning experience on real, business-facing work.

As a Deep Learning Intern, you will work closely with experienced professionals on day-to-day work that directly supports the team's goals, with your core focus on building and training deep neural networks. You'll get structured onboarding, regular feedback and the chance to own tasks end to end rather than watching from the sidelines. This is a genuine learning role: questions are encouraged and your growth is taken seriously.

What you'll do day to day:
• designing and training neural networks
• preprocessing image / text / signal data
• tuning hyperparameters and architectures
• evaluating and visualising model results
• collaborating with the team, documenting your work and acting on feedback

You'll build hands-on experience with Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Neural Networks, CNN, Deep Learning — the exact tools and skills that make a fresher stand out. No prior work experience is required; a genuine interest in machine learning, a willingness to learn and self-motivation matter far more than a polished CV.

Who should apply: students in their final year or recent graduates based in or willing to work from Coimbatore, who are curious, dependable and excited to learn Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch on real projects. If you have built anything on your own — college projects, side projects or coursework — that's a big plus.

Expect to leave with hands-on experience, exposure to industry tools and workflows, and the kind of real-world confidence that sets strong freshers apart in the job market. Outstanding interns can convert to a full-time offer at the end of the internship.

Ready to start your machine learning career with Wipro in Coimbatore? Click Apply Now — if you are not logged in you'll be asked to sign in and register first, after which you'll be taken to Wipro's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so apply early as verified seats are limited. Responsibilities: designing and training neural networks; preprocessing image / text / signal data; tuning hyperparameters and architectures; evaluating and visualising model results; Collaborate with the team and document your work; Take ownership of assigned tasks and act on feedback. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed a relevant degree (stream depends on the role) — 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Foundational knowledge of Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch (or a strong willingness to learn them); Good communication, problem-solving and a genuine eagerness to learn; Based in or willing to work from Coimbatore; A portfolio, project or coursework you can show (a plus, not mandatory).

jobs_results.title: Project Management Intern at Wipro
jobs_results.description:
Wipro is hiring a Project Management Intern in Pune for a 12-month, fully mentored internship. This is real, reviewed work on live projects — not a training sandbox or a certificate mill.

About the internship
You will join the project management team and work alongside people who do this professionally every day. From week one you own a scoped piece of work, take it through review, and see it ship.

Day-to-day responsibilities
• Track project timelines, tasks and dependencies.
• Prepare status reports for stakeholders.
• Coordinate across teams to unblock work.
• Maintain project documentation and risk logs.
• Document your work clearly so the next person can pick it up.
• Take part in stand-ups, planning and review sessions with the team.

Tools and technologies you will use
Project Planning, JIRA, MS Excel, Stakeholder Communication, Agile, Risk Tracking, Documentation, Scheduling, Reporting, Coordination — plus the internal tooling Wipro uses day to day.

What you will learn
How projects are kept on track: planning, surfacing risk early and communicating status honestly.

Team structure
You report to a senior team member who acts as your mentor, inside a pod of 6-10 people. Weekly 1:1s track progress and a mid-internship review tells you exactly where you stand.

What we expect from you
Curiosity, ownership and clear communication. You are not expected to know every tool listed — you are expected to have solid fundamentals, ask good questions, and document what you do.

Details: ₹18,000/month stipend · 12 months · Hybrid · 4 openings · Pune.

If you want to start a career in project management in Pune, apply now. Responsibilities: Track project timelines, tasks and dependencies.; Prepare status reports for stakeholders.; Coordinate across teams to unblock work.; Maintain project documentation and risk logs.; Document your work so the next person can pick it up. Requirements: Education: pursuing or completed BBA/MBA/PGDM or an equivalent degree; Graduation year: 2025, 2026 or 2027 batch; Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA (relaxable for candidates with strong practical projects); Technical skills: working knowledge of Project Planning, JIRA, MS Excel, Stakeholder Communication; Soft skills: clear written communication, ownership, willingness to document work; Experience: none required — freshers welcome; prior projects or certifications are a plus.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst Intern
jobs_results.description:
Wipro has an exciting Data Analyst internship opening in Colvale, Goa, ideal for freshers and final-year students eager to learn by doing. Over this internship you will focus on analysing data and building dashboards and reports, collaborate with the team, and develop skills that employers actively look for.

About the Role
As a Data Analyst at Wipro in Colvale, Goa, you will focus on analysing data and building dashboards and reports. You will have clear responsibilities, the tools and mentorship to succeed, and the chance to make a genuine impact while you learn.

Key Responsibilities
• Extract and analyse data using SQL and Excel
• Build interactive dashboards in Power BI / Tableau
• Identify trends, patterns and actionable insights
• Prepare clear reports and present them to teams
• Automate recurring reporting where possible
• Document your work clearly and act on feedback
• Coordinate with team members and maintain professional communication

Required Skills & Competencies
• SQL
• Advanced Excel
• Power BI
• Tableau
• Python
• Data Visualization
• Data Cleaning
• Statistics
• Dashboarding
• Reporting

What You Will Learn
• Business intelligence and dashboarding tools
• Data storytelling and stakeholder reporting
• SQL and analytics best practices

Who Can Apply
• Students in their final year and recent graduates interested in a Data Analyst role
• Freshers looking to build a career in Data Analyst
• Candidates who know or are learning SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau
• Candidates based in or willing to work from Colvale, Goa
• Career-switchers and self-taught learners who meet the requirements

Stipend & Internship Details
• Stipend: ₹12,000 – ₹28,000 per month
• Duration: 3–6 months
• Location: Colvale, Goa (In-office)
• Joining: Immediate / Rolling

Benefits & Perks
• Internship Certificate on completion
• Letter of Recommendation for strong performers
• Hands-on mentorship from professionals
• Real, portfolio-worthy project experience
• Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity
• Flexible, learning-focused environment

Interview / Selection Process (4 rounds)
Round 1 — Application & Resume Screening: apply through the verified link on this page; profiles are shortlisted on fundamentals, skills and fit for the Data Analyst role.
Round 2 — Aptitude / Skills Assessment: a short test or task covering data analyst fundamentals and basic SQL.
Round 3 — Technical / Task Interview: hands-on discussion of the required skills (SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI) and a case or exercise.
Round 4 — HR / Mentor Round: your learning mindset, availability, stipend and start date.

Industry & Category
Industry: Information Technology & Software, Banking & Financial Services, Finance & Accounting, Retail. Category: Data Analyst. This is a Information Technology & Software, Banking & Financial Services, Finance & Accounting, Retail internship in Colvale, Goa. Popular related searches: Data Analyst internship in Goa, Data Analyst internship in Colvale, Information Technology & Software internships in Panaji Goa, Data Analyst careers in Goa.

Why Join Wipro
Wipro is a respected name in the IT Services sector with a strong presence connected to Goa. You will gain real exposure, work with industry-standard tools and grow alongside experienced professionals in one of India's most vibrant states.

How to Apply
Click "Apply Now" on this page. You will first be asked to log in or create a free candidate account, and you will then be securely redirected to Wipro's official careers/application page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so early applicants have the best chance. Responsibilities: Extract and analyse data using SQL and Excel; Build interactive dashboards in Power BI / Tableau; Identify trends, patterns and actionable insights; Prepare clear reports and present them to teams; Automate recurring reporting where possible; Document work clearly and act on feedback. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed a relevant degree/diploma; Working knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau; Strong communication skills and a proactive attitude; Ability to work in a team and meet deadlines; Based in or open to working from Colvale, Goa.
